extension.description: Opens the official Claude Code chat and shows, file by file, what Claude changed, so you can accept or reject each change. Independent extension: not an Anthropic product.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: The review can restore files and set up local hooks. Trust the workspace to enable the launcher.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: The review and the change log need folders on the local disk. Opening the chat depends on the official extension supporting this kind of workspace.
command.hideInlineChanges: Hide Markers (Accepts Claude's Changes in This File)
command.acceptAllChanges: Accept All of Claude's Changes in This File
command.rejectAllChanges: Reject All of Claude's Changes in This File
command.acceptEverything: Accept All Pending Changes by Claude
command.rejectEverything: Reject All Pending Changes by Claude
config.inlineChanges: Shows the review of Claude's changes in the editor, keeping partial decisions and blocking actions when there is a conflict.
config.manageEditorGroups: Lets the launcher organize the chat editor groups and manage its opening preferences. When turned off, only values that still match what the launcher set are restored.
config.hookExecutionMode: Execution format of the change log. Versions without confirmed support stay disabled; there is no automatic shell fallback. Applies to the machine: a project's settings do not change this option.
config.historyExcludedPatterns: Path patterns excluded from new content copies in the local history. Patterns set in the project add to the user's and do not replace them. Changing the list does not delete existing copies.
config.historyRetentionDays: Retention of the already reviewed history, in days. Zero turns off cleanup by age. Pending changes and data needed for recovery are kept.
config.historyMaxStorageMB: Local storage limit of the history, in MiB. When the limit is reached, new captures are suspended without deleting pending reviews.
config.hookExecutionMode.auto: Turns hooks on only when the selected Claude Code declares support for a separate executable and arguments.
config.hookExecutionMode.exec: Uses a separate executable and arguments after you confirm your Claude Code version supports this format.
config.hookExecutionMode.disabled: Turns off installing and running the hooks managed by the launcher.
config.language: Language of the launcher interface. "auto" follows the editor language: Portuguese when the editor is in Portuguese, English otherwise. Command and setting titles always follow the editor language. The change fully applies after reloading the window.
color.pendingChangeForeground: Color of files with changes by Claude to review, in the Explorer.
walkthrough.title: Get started with Launcher for Claude Code
walkthrough.description: Open the Claude Code chat and follow, file by file, what Claude changed.
walkthrough.install.title: Install Claude Code
walkthrough.install.description:
The chat, sign-in and models come from Anthropic's official extension.
[Install Claude Code](command:claude-code-launcher.install)
walkthrough.openFolder.title: Open the project folder
walkthrough.openFolder.description:
Conversations and review data are tied to the open folder.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
walkthrough.enableChangeLog.title: Turn on the change log
walkthrough.enableChangeLog.description:
Adds a hook to this project that keeps the before and after of every edit by Claude. Needs Node.js on the PATH.
[Turn on change log](command:claude-code-launcher.enableChangeLog)
walkthrough.newChat.title: Start a new conversation
walkthrough.newChat.description:
Claude loads the hook when a conversation starts; conversations that were already open record nothing.
[New conversation](command:claude-code-launcher.newTab)
walkthrough.review.title: Review what Claude changed
walkthrough.review.description:
Accept or reject each file or hunk, in the panel or right in the editor.
[Open Changes](command:claude-code-launcher.showChanges)
config.captureCommandChanges: With the change log on, also records what terminal commands, MCP tools and generators changed, at the end of each Claude reply. The project state is noted when you send a request, with copies of text files within the storage budget; .git, node_modules and the root .gitignore are skipped.
